migrations.risk: Application-integrity risk: this adds immutable, body-free message-to-task provenance and durable operation receipts. The migration is additive and copies no message body or existing task data.
migrations.rollbackPlan: Disable the promotion route while retaining committed tasks, immutable links, and receipts. Do not drop acknowledged data as an operational rollback.
postconditions: work links bind an exact source Project, conversation, message revision, audience epoch, destination Project and task
work links have no body or excerpt column
relationship guards reject mismatched task and source identity even with foreign keys disabled
operation receipts are immutable and bind one actor request to one task and link
operation receipts retain source and destination authorization scope without cascading task or link foreign keys
